title: Rory and the Lantern Leaf Grove
verses:
The sun tucked away in a blanket of blue,
The grass on the hills was all dusted in dew.
Now Rory walked under the lantern-leaf trees,
And listened for bedtime to float on the breeze.

Then Tilly stepped softly across the dark ground,
And Benny sat down without making a sound.
The ferns started glowing with amber and white,
To give all the friends a sweet cushion of light.

Now Ricky stopped bouncing to curl on a log,
Beside a cool stream and a soft misty bog.
And Nia flew down from the top of the ridge,
To rest her tired wings by a mossy stone bridge.

Then Psittaco snuggled on Benny's soft side,
Where all of the shadows were gentle and wide.
He chirped a soft song as the breezes blew by,
And rocked all the treetops with one sleepy sigh.

The glow from the leaves made a cozy warm bed,
Where Rory could rest his big heavy green head.
And Tilly stretched out in the soft clover deep,
And drifted right into a beautiful sleep.

The forest was quiet, the world was at rest,
Each dinosaur cuddled inside a soft nest.
So close your eyes now as the starlight shines bright,
Goodnight to you, Rory, goodnight and goodnight.
